card.factHeader: The "family meal" scene was designed as a pivotal moment for Adam's acceptance.

factBeats.text: Culinary advisor Mario Batali stated that Adam sharing a family meal with his staff was intended to be the most "crystallized moment" of him finally joining the team.
Batali explained that the scene aimed to convey the satisfaction of the whole team realizing Adam was truly part of their family.
Actor Bradley Cooper noted he hadn't experienced this tradition in his own restaurant work, underscoring the insider knowledge from the film's culinary consultants.
